Muramasa《…Is this…》
Muramasa《Is THIS what it means to fight beside you?! Mido!》
Kageaki"Yes."
Kageaki"As you once said… you are not my guardian."
Kageaki"My comrade in battle. Aren't you! Don't try to protect me. Don't try to save me. Use me up and win!"
Muramasa《…My role is not to shelter you.》
Muramasa《My role…》
Kageaki"Go, Muramasa! Fulfil the purpose!"
Kageaki"That is the egg!"
Muramasa《————UNDERSTOOD!!》

en.html:
…Yes.
The equation for defeating Hikaru Minato—the Silver Star.

Kill the ga, become mu, and strike down the enemy.

The principle of selflessness.

Selfless, the hero kills the demon king and saves the world.

Do not forget.
Think carefully about what it means.

Mido.

…Just once is all right, no?
I really wanted to call you that.

……そう。
　これが湊斗光――銀星号打倒の方程式。

　<ruby>我<rt>ガ</rt></ruby>を殺し、<ruby>無<rt>ム</rt></ruby>となって敵を討つ。

　無我の理念。

　英雄は無我なれば魔王を殺し世界を救う。

　忘れないで。
　<ruby>意味<rt>・・</rt></ruby>を良く考えてね。

　御堂。

　……一度くらい、いいでしょ？
　本当は、こう呼ばせて欲しかったんだ。
